relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Altogether, the SCI causes a dramatic loss of GABAergic inhibitory neurons in the dorsal spinal cord, which is highly associated with CNP development.

relationships.subject: iGABAPs
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, levels of GFAP and CSPG near iGABAPs grafts were significantly reduced

relationships.subject: iGABAPs
relationships.evidence_quote: the iGABAPs treatment significantly reduced apoptosis in the host tissue

relationships.subject: iGABAPs
relationships.evidence_quote: induced GABAergic progenitor grafts significantly improved central neuropathic pain as early as 6 weeks after grafting

key_findings: PTF1A+LBX1+ASCL1 converts human pluripotent stem cells into dorsal spinal GABAergic progenitors efficiently.
iGABAP grafts reduce apoptosis and glial scar CSPG, promote axon outgrowth and improve neuropathic pain and locomotion after SCI.
